items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Our first records with Columbia were made in late ’65 or early ’66 with John Hammond.

ctx.x: And the wrong time. Our first records with Columbia were made in late ’65 or early ’66 with John Hammond. Those titles you mentioned were on there. It was – Clockwise was one of the songs.
Okay. So then, your first – as you say, your first LP or album would have been the Live.
